findings: Fashion brand apps are thin: Nike 1, Zara 2, Adidas 3, GOAT 1, H&M 1 shots; none shows product browsing, size selection, wishlist, checkout or purchase
Nike page states all app shots require PRO; counts there may be understated
Only the Shop app (6 shots) has cart interactions: Add to Cart Image Drop, Cart Sheet
Recurring fashion-app motifs: logo splash/zoom (Nike, Zara, Adidas), swipe between departments or categories (Zara, H&M), story-style intros (Adidas)
Tags are not shown per shot; interaction types above are inferred from titles/descriptions

useful_for_skyyrose.cart: Shop Add to Cart Image Drop (product thumbnail flies into the bag) and Cart Sheet (bottom sheet): the reference pair for add-to-bag feedback
useful_for_skyyrose.navigation: H&M header swipe and Zara department swipe: horizontal category/collection switching, relevant to the 4-collection structure
useful_for_skyyrose.avoid: Adidas story stepper and Duolingo-style onboarding: wrong register for a streetwear storefront

shopping_app_pages.gap: The library has almost no product-detail, size-selector or checkout motion for fashion; that part of the vocabulary has to come from collectui, landdding Fashion & Beauty, or first-principles Motion work
